model_annotation: This chart illustrates the percentage of “BIP” (Gross Domestic Product) attributed to different categories of German entities over time. The horizontal axis represents years, ranging from 1995 to 2023, with tick labels spaced approximately every five years. The vertical axis displays the percentage of “BIP” as a continuous scale, ranging from -0.5% to 3.5%, with tick intervals of 0.5%. The left vertical axis represents the percentage of “BIP” contributed by the “Bund” (Federal Government) and “Gemeinden” (municipalities), indicated by a blue bar. The right vertical axis represents the percentage of “BIP” contributed by “Gebietskörpern insgesamt” (total regional bodies) and “Gemeindenkörpern insgesamt” (total municipal bodies), represented by a green shaded area. The blue bar for the “Bund” reaches approximately 2.0% in 2005 and decreases to approximately 1.5% in 2023. The green shaded area for “Gebietskörpern insgesamt” fluctuates between approximately 0.5% and 2.0% over the period, with a peak of approximately 1.8% in 2005. The black line represents the average of the two vertical axes, showing a general trend of decreasing values from 1995 to 2023.  The bars and shaded area are not sorted in any particular order.
